title: Chapter 208
text:
"If Xiao Jin really works with Black Phantom, it will be bad. It means that he has a weapon of mass destruction, and he can even seize power by force," someone said.

Todd shook his head. "They wouldn't dare. If there is a sudden change in the headquarters, and the upper echelons of all the factions are massacred, the people outside will take revenge on the enemies until they are dead. Xiao Jin is not stupid, and Black Phantom is an outsider. According to the rules, outsiders are not allowed to interfere with our internal changes."

Lagos sneered and said, "Stupid, how do you know Xiao Jin didn't find a better place to go? Does he not have other forces behind him? His heart may not be in Overmera anymore! "

…

Xiao Jin closed his eyes and asked, "What's the Home Faction doing?"

"Lagos is in charge of the overall situation. They are investigating Delot's death, but there is no progress. Oh, Delot's mansion was destroyed by Black Phantom during the battle, and the clues are lost."

Xiao Jin paused. "Who ordered to bring Black Phantom to the scene?"

"The team leader who went to control Black Phantom was called Miri. He died in the battle, shot by a stray bullet."

"Stray bullet … Ha." Xiao Jin shook his head. "What is Black Phantom doing?"

"He didn't do anything."

"A wise choice." Xiao Jin nodded and said, "Before the truth of Delot's assassination is revealed, no faction is willing to contact him. Once they do, they will become the target of public criticism."

"Those Inhumans are working for him. I still don't understand why he can easily order them around," Xiao Hai said.

"Don't worry about him, he can't be the murderer."

After a pause, Xiao Jin asked, "What's the Red Island Faction and Northern School doing?"

"They are cooperating with the Home Faction to find clues."

Xiao Jin rubbed his temples and sighed. "Sigh, the dog that bites doesn't bark …"

…

Se Qi sat in his office and pulled down all the curtains. He dialed a phone and lowered his voice.

"Major General, what should we do now?"

"What do you think?"

"Delot is dead, and the position of the Head of the House is vacant. We must elect a successor. I will participate in the election. I hope you can support me."

"Yes, I will use my connections to help you get votes from the higher-ups. When you take control of Overmera, remember how you got there. Don't forget the promise you made with us."

"Definitely."

After hanging up the phone, Se Qi let out a sigh of relief and revealed a sinister smile. His Shanus skin wrinkled together.

…

Han Xiao was very patient. Every day, he would stay in his room. The members of the Bamboo Rain Guild would act as his eyes and ears, gathering information. Although it was not much, it would not make him blind.

In return, Han Xiao wasn't stingy with giving quests to the players of the Bamboo Rain Guild … Then, he opened the skill shop to earn their experience. Going back and forth, he was definitely earning.

As mentioned before, as long as Han Xiao's skill level was higher than the player's, repeatedly learning the same skill would increase the skill's level. Han Technician's skills were all maxed out, so he naturally met the requirements. The players of the Bamboo Rain Guild kept on spending their experience on his skill store. One was willing to fight while the other was willing to suffer.

"My basic combat skill is maxed out." Flying Bamboo Rain cheered. The guild members beside him all came up to look at the attributes excitedly.

Bamboo Rain Xuan said, "I'm only level 7."

Bamboo Rain Fragrance chuckled. "It's your fault for sleeping in every day and not coming online so often."

This group of players didn't try to hide their conversation, and Han Xiao heard everything. He found something magical. When the players were talking about things that had nothing to do with the game, the system should have muted them, but he could hear them. Without a doubt, it was the interface's work again.

Tap, tap, tap!

The sound of steady footsteps approached.

Bang, the door was pushed open. There were many soldiers standing outside. Lagos stood in the crowd with his hands behind his back and said coldly, "Black Phantom, I suspect that you are colluding with Xiao Jin to assassinate my father. Get up now and come with me!"

"Where did you get your confidence from?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. Lagos had kept a low profile for so many days. Now that he suddenly attacked, he must have found someone to help him.

As expected, Lagos sneered and took a step back. Two people walked out from the crowd, a man and a woman.

"I see." Han Xiao patted his pants, stood up, and said calmly, "Looks like you spent quite a lot of money."

The man and woman were a couple, Luhn and Vanessa. They were legends in the mercenary world, similar to Han Xiao's position in the assassin world. Their strength was also at the peak of the third level of Blue Star, and they had survived until Version 2.0.

Lagos asked people to contact the strong ones secretly. When they heard that he was going to deal with Black Phantom, many people refused. They didn't dare to be enemies with Han Xiao. Those who dared to come definitely had absolute confidence. He had done his research this time and knew that these two people were at the same level as Han Xiao. It was safest to deal with the two of them together. Black Phantom was definitely not their match.

Lagos sneered. "When I catch you, I'll make you spit out everything you know."

Han Xiao shook his head. "Isn't it good to be alive?"

"Humph, you're quite arrogant." Luhn was a muscular black man. He bumped his fist and said with disdain, "I heard that you're good at sniping, but I'm three meters away now. I won't even give you a chance to shoot. How many punches can you take? Put down your weapon obediently, or I'll paint the floor with your brain matter. "

In an empty space, a third person's voice suddenly sounded. "Long time no see, Mr. Black."

This voice was familiar.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "Hidden Demon? You're here too. "

Hidden Demon didn't answer. The air was filled with murderous intent.

So it wasn't two strong enemies but three. Han Xiao shook his head and smiled. No wonder Lagos looked so confident. To deal with him, he really put in a lot of effort.

Feeling the hostility of the three strong people locking onto him, Han Xiao smiled. The change he was waiting for had finally arrived. This was the chance to show his absolute strength.

The players of Bamboo Rain Guild didn't know what to do. This group of 'extremely dangerous' NPCs, they couldn't mess with any of them.

Whoosh!

A cold wind brushed past. Han Xiao equipped the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor in time and was scratched by the Hidden Demon's nails. After not seeing each other for a few months, the Hidden Demon was two levels higher and stronger than before.

At that time, Han Xiao couldn't do anything to the Hidden Demon, and it ended in a draw.

But now, in terms of improvement speed, the difference between the two was like heaven and earth!

With a wave of his hand, the Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades formed a whirlwind and cut through the air. A series of damage values popped up in the air. A wound opened in the air, and blood dripped down. The next second, the wound shrank and disappeared. The Hidden Demon could tighten his skin to cover the wound.

The Hidden Demon was shocked by the Compounded Magnetic Chain Split Blades and hurriedly backed off.

Before Han Xiao could chase after him, a suffocating pressure came at him. Vanessa pounced forward and smashed her fist down. Han Xiao raised his hands to block, but his hands were sore and painful. He was at a disadvantage in terms of strength. Vanessa and Luhn were both close to LV 60 Pugilists. Their Strength, Agility, and Endurance were much higher than a Mechanic like him.

Suddenly, Luhn followed up quickly. He clenched his fists together and turned them into a black meteor, heavily hitting the armor on Han Xiao's chest.

He felt a pain in his chest, and a high damage value popped up on the interface. This was the advanced technique of the Pugilist class. It ignored part of the physical armor and was called 'hitting a bull through a mountain' by the players in his previous life.

Pugilists who learned the advanced technique were very difficult to deal with, and it gave him a lot of pressure. Han Xiao's expression didn't change. He pulled back and held two guns in his hands. The large caliber bullets shot out. After his shooting skill was maxed out, the power of his guns had increased.

Vanessa waved her hands and released a circular air shield, which bounced off the bullet and disappeared.

"Shockwave Blast." Han Xiao frowned. Another advanced technique. The Pugilist class always had a place no matter the era. This technique was cool and well-rounded.

At this time, the people from the Bamboo Rain Guild opened fire. Although they knew that they could not defeat the enemy, they knew that they had to help since they had chosen Black Phantom's side.

"Pay attention to your positions, don't get too close. Xiao Fei, Ku Ku, keep attacking. Xuanxuan, don't get too close …" Bamboo Rain Fragrance ordered loudly. She had experience in leading a team in dungeons, so she arranged the troops according to the method of fighting bosses.

"Inhumans?" Luhn was irritated. He used his arm to block his eyes. The bullets were bounced away by the protective flames and could not penetrate his skin.

Vanessa swung her leg and pulled out an air blade like a whip. All the players from the Bamboo Rain Guild were cut in half at the waist. They turned into white light and disappeared.

The Bamboo Rain Guild was wiped out. The difference in strength was too big.

Taking advantage of this short moment, Han Xiao picked up the equipment bag full of machines and rushed into the room.

Just as Luhn was about to follow, Vanessa pulled him back. "Be careful, he's a mechanic. There may be traps."

Luhn nodded and punched the floor. Cracks spread rapidly from the center of the punch. The whole house was on the verge of collapsing. The whole house was destroyed, and the battlefield became an open space. No matter what kind of trap Black Phantom had set, it would be destroyed.

Lagos quickly left with the soldiers.

Boom!

The house collapsed. Dust filled the air and blocked the vision.

Luhn narrowed his eyes. He vaguely saw a figure jump out of the ruins. He immediately rushed forward like a war horse. His fist was like a meteor hammer. The flames left a dazzling mark and went straight for the figure's head.

"Down!" Luhn yelled.

However, the next moment, he heard the sound of energy buzzing and a cold mechanical voice.

"Strong Mode!"
